title: Reveal schedule: day 2's menu has three tabs
about: QA round (phase the game's depth), tutorial review. A guided game on day 2 at 11:00 in town, its guided steps done. Open the Menu: Bag, Goal and Opts only. The Book arrives on day 4, Make on day 9 and Skill on day 12 (or the moment play needs them). The onboarding gate's day 1 and 2 are otherwise as before.
